blurb: The center offers comprehensive dance training for children and adults, focusing on various styles including ballet, modern, jazz, tap, hip-hop, and musical theater. It includes a modern dance repertory company, Dancefusion, dedicated to reconstructing historic works and creating new choreography. The junior company, fusion2, provides advanced training and performance opportunities for young dancers.
extraNote: Partial scholarships awarded based on merit and financial need through audition · Year-round
